verdict.rationale: WooCommerce publishes a REST API reference with versioned endpoints such as GET /wp-json/wc/v3/products, plus key-generation guidance and official client libraries in JS, PHP, Python and Ruby. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path, which would normally power a try-it console. Missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable in-browser examples, published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent corroboration.
